newsitem.title: USA: CVS in talks to acquire Revco - report.
newsitem.headline: CVS in talks to acquire Revco - report.

text.p: CVS Corp is in talks to acquire Revco D.S. Inc, but it is not clear if a deal will be completed, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The newspaper quoted people familiar with the situation as saying the talks had progressed beyond the preliminary stage.
Any merger would be scrutinized by the Federal Trade Commission, which rejected Revco's proposed purchase by Rite Aid Corp, the report said.
Any deal would also need the support of Revco co-Chairman Sam Zell, who owns about 20 percent of the company through Zell/Chilmark Fund LP, the report said.
If a deal goes through, it would create a drugstore chain with $11 billion in revenues, although CVS may be forced to sell some stores to meet antitrust requirements, it said.
